summary: JD.com, Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce the record date for its upcoming annual general meeting of shareholders. The record date is June 4, 2026, for ordinary shares and ADS holders. No special situation transaction, corporate action, or event beyond a routine meeting is disclosed. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a standard procedural notice for a shareholder meeting.
